articles.image_title: Feuer in Südeuropa: Firefighters work to extinguish a wildfire raging since four days in the Megara Region, west of Athens on August 3, 2026. Wildfires that have raged for four days west of Athens remained a threat on August 3, 2026, with flames flaring up again despite easing winds and the deployment of firefighting aircraft. Firefighters reported a slight improvement in conditions earlier in the day, but authorities later warned of fresh flare-ups on one of the main fire fronts near Megara, about 30 kilometres (19 miles) west of the capital. (Photo by Aris Oikonomou / AFP via Getty Images)
